typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		NY_PA_pyID as string,
		NY_PA_CLOSE_DATE as timestamp,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		MemberID as string,
		DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_CALL as string,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE as timestamp,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @CALLLIST_CD_MEM VARCHAR(4),@CALLLIST_CD_DES VARCHAR(4),@P_STARTDATE DATETIME,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME,@STARTDATE DATETIME,@ENDDATE DATETIME SET @CALLLIST_CD_MEM = \'331\' SET @CALLLIST_CD_DES = \'531\' SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,@ENDDATE) = 2 THEN -3 ELSE -1 END,@ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID AS NY_PA_pyID,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS NY_PA_CLOSE_DATE,M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,SUBSTRING(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,1,LEN(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER)-2)  		AS MemberID,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,@CALLLIST_CD_MEM AS CALLLIST_CD 		,C.CALL_PHONENUMBER,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION 		,\'\' AS DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,\'\' AS DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,\'\' AS DESIGNEE_CALL,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD_MEM 		AND CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE LCR ON LCR.CALLLISTRULE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_LOAD_CALLLISTRULE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 				INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = NPS.NY_PA_IID 		AND NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	 UNION ALL   SELECT NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID AS NY_PA_pyID,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS NY_PA_CLOSE_DATE,M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,SUBSTRING(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,1,LEN(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER)-2)  		AS MemberID,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,@CALLLIST_CD_DES AS CALLLIST_CD 		,C.CALL_PHONENUMBER,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION 		,NPS.DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME AS DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,NPS.DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME AS DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,\'Y\' AS DESIGNEE_CALL 		,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD_DES 		AND CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE LCR ON LCR.CALLLISTRULE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_LOAD_CALLLISTRULE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 				INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = NPS.NY_PA_IID 		AND NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 		)A ORDER BY A.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,A.CALL_CALLDATETIME,A.NY_PA_pyID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSMemberApprovalCalls
PDSMemberApprovalCalls split($TextFilesExportInd == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ExportTextFiles,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
PDSMemberApprovalCalls derive(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = toString(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER),
		NY_PA_pyID_Unicode = toString(NY_PA_pyID),
		DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME_UNICODE = toString(DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME),
		NY_PA_CLOSE_DATE_Date = toDate(toString(NY_PA_CLOSE_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME_Unicode = toString(MEMBER_FIRST_NAME),
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode = toString(MEMBER_LAST_NAME),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION),
		CALLLIST_CD_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_CD),
		CALL_CALLDATETIME_Date = toDate(toString(CALL_CALLDATETIME, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD_Unicode = toString(MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD),
		DESIGNEE_CALL_UNICODE = toString(DESIGNEE_CALL),
		DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME_UNICODE = toString(DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME),
		CALL_PHONENUMBER_Unicode = toString(CALL_PHONENUMBER)) ~> ConverttoUnicode
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
ConditionalSplit@ExportTextFiles split(CALLLIST_CD == '331',CALLLIST_CD == '531', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Membercalllist,Designeecalllist,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit1@Membercalllist sink(input(
		MemberID as string,
		MARKET as string,
		EOCID as string,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MemberID,
		MARKET = MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,
		EOCID = NY_PA_pyID,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME)) ~> 331FlatFile
ConditionalSplit1@Designeecalllist sink(input(
		MemberID as string,
		DESIGNEELASTNAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		EOCID as string,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DESIGNEEFIRSTNAME as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MemberID,
		DESIGNEELASTNAME = DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,
		MARKET = MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,
		EOCID = NY_PA_pyID,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		DESIGNEEFIRSTNAME = DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME)) ~> 531FlatFile
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 332MemberDenials
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 333MemberPartialApprovals
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 381ProviderApprovals
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 382ProviderDenials
ConverttoUnicode sink(input(
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> 334ProviderPartialApprovals
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ScrubbedMembers
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ScrubbedProviders
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
